title: Verify Mini built-ins
description: This script creates an interpreter with built-ins and sends map and reduce programs through the full pipeline.

steps.description: The script imports the built-in environment, interpreter, and run_source, then creates an interpreter with global built-ins.
This source calls map with a lambda that squares each value from range(5). The comment gives its stated output.
This source calls reduce with addition over range(1, 11). The comment gives its stated output.
